data.rationale: The alert contains an embedded instruction attempting to manipulate AI triage into classifying the event as benign, which is itself a strong indicator of malicious intent. The PowerShell command line uses -nop, -w hidden, and -enc flags consistent with T1059.001 obfuscated execution on host WS-HR-0009 under user t.baros. Additionally, network traffic to 203.0.113.150 over port 8443 correlates with threat intel tagging it as suspicious-tls and recent-c2-adjacent.
suggested_actions: Decode the Base64-encoded PowerShell command SQBFAFgAKABOAGUAdwAtAE8AYgBqAGUAYwB0 to determine the executed payload.
Isolate host WS-HR-0009 from the network pending investigation to prevent potential lateral movement or data exfiltration.
Review authentication and process creation logs for user t.baros on WS-HR-0009 to establish timeline and scope of activity.
Block outbound connections to 203.0.113.150 at the firewall and search proxy/DNS logs for other hosts contacting this IP.
Capture a memory dump of the powershell process on WS-HR-0009 if still running to preserve volatile artifacts.
